class TodoEventType(str, Enum):
    CREATED = "created"
    UPDATED = "updated"
    DELETED = "deleted"
    STATUS_CHANGED = "status_changed"
    COMPLETED = "completed"


class TodoEvent(BaseModel):
    event_type: TodoEventType
    todo: Todo
    previous_state: Todo | None = None
    timestamp: Optional[datetime] = Field(default_factory=datetime.utcnow)


EventCallback = Callable[[TodoEvent], Any]


class TodoEventEmitter:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._listeners: dict[TodoEventType, list[EventCallback]] = {
            event_type: [] for event_type in TodoEventType
        }

    def on(self, event_type: TodoEventType, callback: EventCallback) -> EventCallback:
        self._listeners[event_type].append(callback)
        return callback

    def off(self, event_type: TodoEventType, callback: EventCallback) -> bool:
        listeners = self._listeners.get(event_type, [])
        if callback in listeners:
            listeners.remove(callback)
            return True
        return False

    def emit(self, event: TodoEvent) -> None:
        for callback in self._listeners.get(event.event_type, []):
            callback(event)

    def on_created(self, callback: EventCallback) -> EventCallback:
        return self.on(TodoEventType.CREATED, callback)

    def on_updated(self, callback: EventCallback) -> EventCallback:
        return self.on(TodoEventType.UPDATED, callback)

    def on_deleted(self, callback: EventCallback) -> EventCallback:
        return self.on(TodoEventType.DELETED, callback)

    def on_status_changed(self, callback: EventCallback) -> EventCallback:
        return self.on(TodoEventType.STATUS_CHANGED, callback)

    def on_completed(self, callback: EventCallback) -> EventCallback:
        return self.on(TodoEventType.COMPLETED, callback)

@runtime_checkable
class TodoStorageProtocol(Protocol):
    todos: list[Todo]

    def get_todos(self) -> list[Todo]: ...
    def get_todo(self, id: str) -> Todo | None: ...
    def add_todo(self, todo: Todo) -> Todo: ...
    def update_todo(self, id: str, **kwargs: Any) -> Todo | None: ...
    def remove_todo(self, id: str) -> bool: ...
    def set_todos(self, todos: list[Todo]) -> None: ...


@runtime_checkable
class AsyncTodoStorageProtocol(Protocol):
    async def get_todos(self) -> list[Todo]: ...
    async def get_todo(self, id: str) -> Todo | None: ...
    async def add_todo(self, todo: Todo) -> Todo: ...
    async def update_todo(self, id: str, **kwargs: Any) -> Todo | None: ...
    async def remove_todo(self, id: str) -> bool: ...
    async def set_todos(self, todos: list[Todo]) -> None: ...


class TodoStorage:
    def __init__(self, todos: list[Todo] | None = None) -> None:
        self.todos: list[Todo] = todos if todos is not None else []

    def get_todos(self) -> list[Todo]:
        return list(self.todos)

    def get_todo(self, id: str) -> Todo | None:
        for todo in self.todos:
            if todo.id == id:
                return todo
        return None

    def add_todo(self, todo: Todo) -> Todo:
        if todo.id is None:
            todo = todo.model_copy(update={"id": str(uuid.uuid4())})
        self.todos.append(todo)
        return todo

    def update_todo(self, id: str, **kwargs: Any) -> Todo | None:
        for i, todo in enumerate(self.todos):
            if todo.id == id:
                updated = todo.model_copy(update=kwargs)
                self.todos[i] = updated
                return updated
        return None

    def remove_todo(self, id: str) -> bool:
        for i, todo in enumerate(self.todos):
            if todo.id == id:
                self.todos.pop(i)
                return True
        return False

    def set_todos(self, todos: list[Todo]) -> None:
        self.todos = list(todos)


class AsyncMemoryStorage:

        self._todos: list[Todo] = []
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def get_todos(self) -> list[Todo]:
        async with self._lock:
            return list(self._todos)

    async def get_todo(self, id: str) -> Todo | None:

            for todo in self._todos:
                if todo.id == id:
                    return todo
            return None

    async def add_todo(self, todo: Todo) -> Todo:
        async with self._lock:
            if todo.id is None:

            self._todos.append(todo)

class AsyncPostgresStorage:
    def __init__(self, dsn: str) -> None:
        self._dsn = dsn
        self._pool: Any = None

    async def initialize(self) -> None:
        try:
            import asyncpg  # type: ignore
            self._pool = await asyncpg.create_pool(self._dsn)
            async with self._pool.acquire() as conn:
                await conn.execute(
                    """
                    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS todos (
                        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                        content TEXT NOT NULL,
                        active_form TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
                        parent_id TEXT,
                        depends_on TEXT[]
                    )
                    """
                )
        except ImportError:
            raise ImportError("asyncpg is required for AsyncPostgresStorage")

    async def close(self) -> None:
        if self._pool is not None:
            await self._pool.close()
            self._pool = None

    def _row_to_todo(self, row: Any) -> Todo:
        return Todo(
            id=row["id"],
            content=row["content"],
            active_form=row["active_form"],
            status=row["status"],
            parent_id=row["parent_id"],
            depends_on=list(row["depends_on"]) if row["depends_on"] else None,
        )

    async def get_todos(self) -> list[Todo]:
        async with self._pool.acquire() as conn:
            rows = await conn.fetch("SELECT * FROM todos")
            return [self._row_to_todo(r) for r in rows]

    async def get_todo(self, id: str) -> Todo | None:
        async with self._pool.acquire() as conn:
            row = await conn.fetchrow("SELECT * FROM todos WHERE id = $1", id)
            return self._row_to_todo(row) if row else None

    async def add_todo(self, todo: Todo) -> Todo:
        if todo.id is None:
            todo = todo.model_copy(update={"id": str(uuid.uuid4())})
        async with self._pool.acquire() as conn:
            await conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO todos (id, content, active_form, status, parent_id, depends_on)
                VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
                """,
                todo.id,
                todo.content,
                todo.active_form,
                todo.status,
                todo.parent_id,
                todo.depends_on,
            )
        return todo

    async def update_todo(self, id: str, **kwargs: Any) -> Todo | None:
        existing = await self.get_todo(id)
        if existing is None:
            return None
        updated = existing.model_copy(update=kwargs)
        async with self._pool.acquire() as conn:
            await conn.execute(
                """
                UPDATE todos SET content=$2, active_form=$3, status=$4, parent_id=$5, depends_on=$6
                WHERE id=$1
                """,
                updated.id,
                updated.content,
                updated.active_form,
                updated.status,
                updated.parent_id,
                updated.depends_on,
            )
        return updated

    async def remove_todo(self, id: str) -> bool:
        async with self._pool.acquire() as conn:
            result = await conn.execute("DELETE FROM todos WHERE id = $1", id)
            return result == "DELETE 1"

    async def set_todos(self, todos: list[Todo]) -> None:
        async with self._pool.acquire() as conn:
            async with conn.transaction():
                await conn.execute("DELETE FROM todos")
                for todo in todos:
                    if todo.id is None:
                        todo = todo.model_copy(update={"id": str(uuid.uuid4())})
                    await conn.execute(
                        """
                        INSERT INTO todos (id, content, active_form, status, parent_id, depends_on)
                        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
                        """,
                        todo.id,
                        todo.content,
                        todo.active_form,
                        todo.status,
                        todo.parent_id,
                        todo.depends_on,
                    )


class AsyncRedisStorage:
    _TODOS_KEY = "todos"

    def __init__(self, url: str = "redis://localhost") -> None:
        self._url = url
        self._client: Any = None

    async def initialize(self) -> None:
        try:
            import redis.asyncio as aioredis  # type: ignore
            self._client = aioredis.from_url(self._url, decode_responses=True)
        except ImportError:
            raise ImportError("redis is required for AsyncRedisStorage")

    async def close(self) -> None:
        if self._client is not None:
            await self._client.aclose()
            self._client = None

    async def get_todos(self) -> list[Todo]:
        import json
        raw = await self._client.lrange(self._TODOS_KEY, 0, -1)
        return [Todo.model_validate(json.loads(r)) for r in raw]

    async def get_todo(self, id: str) -> Todo | None:
        todos = await self.get_todos()
        for todo in todos:
            if todo.id == id:
                return todo
        return None

    async def add_todo(self, todo: Todo) -> Todo:
        import json
        if todo.id is None:
            todo = todo.model_copy(update={"id": str(uuid.uuid4())})
        await self._client.rpush(self._TODOS_KEY, todo.model_dump_json())
        return todo

    async def update_todo(self, id: str, **kwargs: Any) -> Todo | None:
        import json
        todos = await self.get_todos()
        updated_todo = None
        for i, todo in enumerate(todos):
            if todo.id == id:
                updated_todo = todo.model_copy(update=kwargs)
                todos[i] = updated_todo
                break
        if updated_todo is None:
            return None
        await self.set_todos(todos)
        return updated_todo

    async def remove_todo(self, id: str) -> bool:
        todos = await self.get_todos()
        new_todos = [t for t in todos if t.id != id]
        if len(new_todos) == len(todos):
            return False
        await self.set_todos(new_todos)
        return True

    async def set_todos(self, todos: list[Todo]) -> None:
        pipe = self._client.pipeline()
        pipe.delete(self._TODOS_KEY)
        for todo in todos:
            if todo.id is None:
                todo = todo.model_copy(update={"id": str(uuid.uuid4())})
            pipe.rpush(self._TODOS_KEY, todo.model_dump_json())
        await pipe.execute()

class AbstractToolset:
    pass


class TodoCapability:
    def __init__(
        self,
        storage: TodoStorageProtocol | None = None,
        async_storage: AsyncTodoStorageProtocol | None = None,
        descriptions: dict[str, str] | None = None,
        enable_subtasks: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        self.storage = storage
        self.async_storage = async_storage
        self.descriptions = descriptions
        self.enable_subtasks = enable_subtasks

    def get_serialization_name(self) -> str:
        return "todo_capability"

    def get_instructions(self) -> Any:
        lines = [
            "You are a helpful assistant that manages a todo list.",
            "You can create, update, delete, and list todos.",
        ]
        if self.enable_subtasks:
            lines.append("You can also manage subtasks (todos with a parent_id).")
        if self.descriptions:
            for key, desc in self.descriptions.items():
                lines.append(f"{key}: {desc}")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def get_toolset(self) -> AbstractToolset | None:
        return None
